19: “Place me as a seal” (Song of Songs 8:6)—Rabbi Berekhyah said:  “This refers to the recitation of the Shema, as it says:  “And these matters… shall be upon your heart” (Deuteronomy 6:6). “As a seal upon your arm”—This refers to tefillin, and this is what is meant when it says, “And you shall bind them upon your arm” (Deuteronomy 6:8).
